prompts.title: Personal information
prompts.situation: You are meeting a Spanish-speaking person for the first time.
points: your name and where you are from
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You are meeting a Spanish-speaking person for the first time.

Task: Answer questions about yourself. Include: your name and where you are from; where you live; your work or studies; your languages; your hobbies.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: Describe your family
prompts.situation: You are showing a Spanish-speaking friend a photograph of your family.
prompts.task: Describe the people in the photograph.
points: one thing you like doing with your family
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You are showing a Spanish-speaking friend a photograph of your family.

Task: Describe the people in the photograph. Include: who the people are; their names and ages; where they live; what they do; one thing you like doing with your family.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: Your favourite place
prompts.situation: A Spanish-speaking friend asks you about your favourite place in your town or city.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: A Spanish-speaking friend asks you about your favourite place in your town or city.

Task: Describe the place. Include: where it is; what it looks like; what you can do there; when you usually go there; why you like it.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: A typical day
prompts.situation: Your teacher asks you to describe a normal day in your life.
points: what you do in the morning
what you do during the afternoon
what you do in the evening
what you like most about your day
prompts.prompt:
Situation: Your teacher asks you to describe a normal day in your life.

Task: Describe your typical day. Include: when you get up; what you do in the morning; what you do during the afternoon; what you do in the evening; what you like most about your day.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: Choosing an activity
prompts.situation: You and another student want to do something together this weekend.
prompts.task: Look at the available activities and discuss your choice. ====================
points: which activity you would like to choose
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You and another student want to do something together this weekend.

Task: Look at the available activities and discuss your choice. ==================== Include: what activities you like; what you do not like; when you are free; where you can go; which activity you would like to choose.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: A memorable day
prompts.situation: A Spanish-speaking friend asks you about a day you remember well.
prompts.task: Tell your friend about the day.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: A Spanish-speaking friend asks you about a day you remember well.

Task: Tell your friend about the day. Include: when and where it happened; who you were with; what happened; how you felt; why you remember the day.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.

prompts.title: Describe a picture and tell a story
prompts.situation: You are given a photograph showing people in a public place.
prompts.task: Describe the photograph and imagine what is happening.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You are given a photograph showing people in a public place.

Task: Describe the photograph and imagine what is happening. Include: where the people are; what they are doing; what they might be saying; what happened before the photograph; what might happen afterwards.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.

prompts.title: Planning a day out
prompts.situation: You and another person want to spend a free day together.
prompts.task: Discuss the possibilities and make a plan.
points: which plan you prefer and why
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You and another person want to spend a free day together.

Task: Discuss the possibilities and make a plan. Include: where you could go; what you could do; how you could travel; how much time you have; which plan you prefer and why.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.

prompts.title: A problem while travelling
prompts.situation: Imagine that you are travelling and something goes wrong.
prompts.task: Explain the situation and say what you would do.
points: who you would ask for help
prompts.prompt:
Situation: Imagine that you are travelling and something goes wrong.

Task: Explain the situation and say what you would do. Include: losing your luggage; missing a train or bus; losing your phone; arriving at the wrong hotel; what happened; what you need; who you would ask for help; what you would do next.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.

prompts.title: Comparing two ways of spending free time
prompts.situation: You have two different options for your free time, for example staying at home or going out with friends.
prompts.task: Compare the two options and explain your choice.
points: what you can do in each situation
what you normally do in your free time
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You have two different options for your free time, for example staying at home or going out with friends.

Task: Compare the two options and explain your choice. Include: what you can do in each situation; the advantages of each option; what you prefer; why you prefer it; what you normally do in your free time.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.

prompts.title: An important experience
prompts.situation: Your examiner asks you to talk about an experience that was important to you.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: Your examiner asks you to talk about an experience that was important to you.

Task: Give a short presentation. Include: what the experience was; when and where it happened; who was involved; what happened; why the experience was important; what you learned from it.

Speak for approximately 2-3 minutes.

prompts.title: Choosing a holiday
prompts.situation: You and another person want to organise a holiday together. You have several possible options, such as a beach holiday, a city trip, a countryside trip or an activity holiday.
prompts.task: Discuss the options and reach a decision.
points: describe the advantages of different options
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You and another person want to organise a holiday together. You have several possible options, such as a beach holiday, a city trip, a countryside trip or an activity holiday.

Task: Discuss the options and reach a decision. Include: describe the advantages of different options; discuss possible disadvantages; consider cost, transport and activities; explain your preferences; agree on one option.

Speak for approximately 3-4 minutes.

prompts.title: The advantages and disadvantages of working from home
prompts.situation: You have been asked to discuss whether working from home is a good option for employees.
prompts.task: Give your opinion and discuss the issue. Give reasons and examples to support your ideas.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You have been asked to discuss whether working from home is a good option for employees.

Task: Give your opinion and discuss the issue. Give reasons and examples to support your ideas. Include: advantages for workers; possible disadvantages; effects on productivity; social interaction; your own experience or expectations.

Speak for approximately 2-3 minutes.

prompts.title: Planning an event
prompts.situation: Your school, workplace or local community wants to organise an event to bring people together.
prompts.task: Discuss how you would organise the event. Work together to agree on a plan.
points: what kind of event to organise
where and when it should take place
prompts.prompt:
Situation: Your school, workplace or local community wants to organise an event to bring people together.

Task: Discuss how you would organise the event. Work together to agree on a plan. Include: what kind of event to organise; where and when it should take place; who should be invited; activities and entertainment; food and drink; how to advertise it.

Speak for approximately 3-4 minutes.

prompts.title: A problem that needs a solution
prompts.situation: Imagine that a group of students in your city are having difficulty finding affordable ways to spend their free time.
prompts.task: Discuss possible solutions. Explain which solutions you think would be useful and why. Respond to the other person's suggestions and reach an agreement.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: Imagine that a group of students in your city are having difficulty finding affordable ways to spend their free time.

Task: Discuss possible solutions. Explain which solutions you think would be useful and why. Respond to the other person's suggestions and reach an agreement. Include: sports and fitness activities; cultural events; public spaces; clubs and community activities; online activities.

Speak for approximately 3-4 minutes.
